title: Vault: deep health probes (seal + raft + transit + auth)
description: Runs `nexus health vault` (+ `--json`). Seven probes all green: per-node seal-status, active-leader election, raft peer quorum, the transit auto-unseal custodian, and operator token authorization.

observe.what: 7 probes green: seal-status x3 (unsealed, active/standby, v1.18.4), active-leader (1 active), raft-peers (3 peers / 3 voters / 1 leader), transit-unseal (unsealed auto-unseal serving), operator-auth (token authorized, 128 policies)
JSON health: 7 checks, all status=green; raft-peers detail = 3 peers/3 voters/1 leader; transit-unseal detail = unsealed serving; operator-auth detail = 128 policies

whatProves: VaultAdapter.GetHealthAsync runs seal-status on each node, confirms exactly one active leader and a 3-voter raft quorum, verifies vault-transit is unsealed and serving auto-unseal, and checks the operator token is authorized (128 policies) - all green.
